cohort: 11,455 very low birth weight (VLBW) infants (< 1500 g) from 26 tertiary care and teaching sites in South America between 2000 and 2011.
finding: Factors independently associated with lower mortality in VLBW infants included antenatal corticosteroids, a better birth weight Z-score, arterial hypertension, and C-section.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was independently associated with lower mortality of very low birth weight infants.
